title: Every mention of the same name in one sentence is rewritten independently
why_real: A user mentions the same colleague three times in one sentence, and each mention gets its own independent decide call, so the rewrite must not stop after the first occurrence or treat the sentence as all-or-nothing.

inputs.asr: puja told puja to call puja

expected.memory_aware: Pooja told Pooja to call Pooja.
expected.reason: Each of the three mentions is decided per-token and all three independently APPLY the same memory.
